steps.name: + futility pruning, castling, 1.28x faster search
steps.note: depth 6. Castling measured +19 +/- 39, futility +55 +/- 63, speed converts to zero Elo at fixed depth

steps.name: + mobility and attacker-counting king safety
steps.note: confirmed head-to-head at +16 +/- 12 over 3000 games; the calibration jump is larger than that and is within calibration noise

tech.reference: Deep Blue, which beat Kasparov in 1997, searched about 200M positions/sec on 480 custom chips.

caveat: Calibrations of near-identical builds have returned 1786 to 1955, a spread of about +/- 65, so this figure cannot resolve a small change and the jump to 1955 should not be read as a 100-point gain. The defensible number for the last change is the head-to-head one: +16 +/- 12 over 3000 games, which is 0.85%. Changes are judged that way and calibration only places the result on a public scale.
